title: Pentad Operationalization Manual: Burke A Grammar of Motives (1945) — Dissertation-Deployable Methodology
purpose: Dissertation-facing core deliverable. Operationalizes Burke's pentad (Act/Scene/Agent/Agency/Purpose) for game-user-motive analysis with four augmentation layers: Calleja PIM, Uexküllian biosemiotics, Aristotelian-Heideggerian ontological grounding, and forward-reference to Burke 1950 Rhetoric of Motives (Attitude as 6th term).

provenance_legend.burke-direct: Burke's own claim, page-anchored to Grammar of Motives
provenance_legend.exegetical-direct: Burke himself anchors the term to a prior thinker (only Act↔Aristotle/Aquinas qualifies)
provenance_legend.anticipatory-projection: Dissertation augmentation; convergence without Burke's textual contact (Calleja/Uexküll mappings; most Heidegger anchors)
provenance_legend.pending-future-rhetoric-of-motives-pipel: Will require Burke 1950 Rhetoric of Motives synthesis to consolidate

content_filter_compliance: All Burke prose paraphrased; no ≥25-word verbatim passages; ≤7-word locutions retained only where load-bearing technical terms.

section_A_pentad_terms.operational_definition: Act is the pentad term answering 'what was done?'. On Burke's realist construal (GM-06), an act is an actualization — the bringing of a potentiality (dynamis) into full realization (energeia) in accordance with a form proper to its kind. An act has internal directionality (entelechy: end-within-itself), is reciprocally related to potency, and is distinguishable from mere motion (which lies in instruments).
paradigm_examples_burke: Hero-file example: breaking one's bonds in order to escape (GM-00 p.xx)
Bond-breaking + escape; Aeschylus Erinyes→Eumenides transformation (GM-01 p.20)
Aristotelian energeia/actuality as defining-mark of the real (GM-06 p.227)
Existence as 'the act of essence' (Aquinas; GM-06 p.227)
Soul as 'act of an organic physical body capable of life' (Aquinas on De Anima; GM-06 p.227)
Incipient act (Richards) — perception as response in form of incipient action (GM-06 p.235)
Symbolic action as par excellence the realm of incipient/attitudinal (GM-06 p.243)
Constitutional enactment as Act (GM-08, Declaration of Independence)
section_A_pentad_terms.burke_exegetical_move: Burke reads Aristotle's energeia/entelechy and Aquinas's actus/potentia as the operationalization of Act as motive-locus. The Aristotelian in rebus realism (things-strive-toward-perfection-of-kind) replaces the Platonic ante rem (transcendent Idea generative). Burke distinguishes act from motion via the action-motion watershed: reduction-to-motion crosses out of dramatism into operationalism/scenic-reduction. Three intermediate states extend the term: attitude (Mead), incipient act (Richards), delayed act.
decision_rules: If a vocabulary derives motive from actualization in accordance with form-of-kind, classify as featuring Act.
If a vocabulary reduces act to motion (no internal source of movement), classify as scenic-reduction.
If a vocabulary treats action as substitute for or beginning of overt action, classify as incipient-act territory (rhetoric, symbolic action).
If the verb has connotations of consciousness or purpose, it is an act-unit (GM-01 p.14).

An Aristotelian classification first by tribal/familial substance (then deriving individuals) is realist-Act-featuring; classification first by individual-things-then-aggregates is nominalist (not realist).

dissertation_calleja_pim_mapping.rationale_le60: Act = actualization of plans into executed moves. Calleja's strategy/tactics/microtactic hierarchy is a phenomenology of act-formation under rule-system constraint. Narrative involvement is featured-act involvement (plot as foremost element of tragedy, Burke p.230). Kinesthetic carries the physical-input pole of the act.

dissertation_uexkull_mapping.rationale_le60: Burke's Act-as-what-was-done parallels the Wirkmal-actualization pole of Uexküll's functional cycle — the effect-side completion of the receptor/effector loop in which the subject acts upon the meaning-carrier in its Umwelt.

dissertation_ontological_target.rationale_le60: UNIQUE EXEGETICAL anchor in the pipeline. Burke devotes GM-06 to Aristotle/Aquinas; cites Baldwin's Dictionary chain at p.227; treats 'existence as act of essence' and 'soul as act of body' directly. Cross-anchor to existing Aristotle Complete Works + Phantasia Cluster corpus indices.
corpus_anchors: Aristotle Complete Works (Metaphysics IX, Physics I.6-7, De Anima, Poetics 6, Nicomachean Ethics)

forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.textual_seed: Burke explicitly seeds Attitude in GM-06 p.236 ('attitude as beginning of acts', Mead) and p.243 (symbolic action as the realm of incipient/attitudinal); GM-10 stanza V Urn-as-Attitude reading (book p.458); GM-09 1962 Addendum names Attitude as 6th term.
forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.modification: Once Rhetoric of Motives (1950) pipeline is built, Act's incipient-act spectrum will require an Attitude-modifier sub-term capturing the suspended/incipient/symbolic-rehearsal mode of action that mediates between potency and energeia.

section_A_pentad_terms.operational_definition: Scene is the pentad term answering 'where and in what situation was the act done?'. It names the background, setting, situation, or containing environment that frames an act. As containing-principle for action, scene fixes the circumference within which motive may be located; it carries the implicit claim that the act/agent it surrounds can be in part derived from it (the scene-act and scene-agent ratios).
section_A_pentad_terms.question_answered: Where (and in what situation, ground, environment, condition) was the act done?
paradigm_examples_burke: Room of confinement in hero-file example (GM-00 p.xx)
Ibsen Enemy of the People: bourgeois sitting-room (Acts I-II); editorial office (Act III); disordered study (Act V) (GM-01 pp.3-5)
Industrial scene constituted by accumulation of machines (GM-00 p.xx)
Hobbesian external body causing sense and imagination (GM-04 p.133)
Spinozistic God-Nature as scenic substance (GM-04 pp.137-138)
Darwinian 'Conditions of Existence' as higher law (GM-04 p.153)
Lucretian atomic void (GM-04 pp.159-160)
Constitution-behind-the-Constitution as scenic ultimate (GM-08)
section_A_pentad_terms.burke_exegetical_move: Burke (GM-04) diagnoses Materialism as the philosophic terminology corresponding to featuring of Scene. It narrows the scenic circumference such that action is reduced to motion and personal/spiritual causes are excluded; the originating ground of motive is environmental, material, deterministic. Canonical materialists develop a body-and-motion Ausgangspunkt-vocabulary while suppressing, reducing, or scenically deriving the other four pentad terms (Hobbes: will-as-last-appetite; Spinoza: conatus-from-Substance; Darwin: organism-as-agent-minus; Lucretius: clinamen-as-scenic-freedom; Stoicism: purpose-as-providential-scene).
decision_rules: If a motive-statement explains an act primarily by environmental conditions, situation, ground, or surrounding material/social/historical context: scene-featuring.
If a putative agent is described as derived from / reducible to the larger ground (Substance, Conditions of Existence, atomic void): scene-featuring-with-agent-minus.
If action-vocabulary is systematically replaced by motion-vocabulary even where surface terms ('will', 'action') survive: scene-featuring (Hobbes test).
If 'situation' is used to mean motives peculiar to a writer's medium or to men as men: NOT scene-featuring — borrowed by agency/agent-featuring schools (GM-04 pp.129-130).
If a putative scenic ground is endowed with purposive/rational properties (Stoic pronoia) or internal-tendency-to-deviate (Epicurean clinamen): scene-featuring-with-pre-agentification.
Resolve scene/agent ambiguity by tracing the Ausgangspunkt — whether ground-terms are generative of self-movement-terms or vice versa.

dissertation_calleja_pim_mapping.rationale_le60: Scene-as-blanket-container maps onto Calleja's Spatial involvement (the navigable virtual environment as bounded subjectively-constituted place). The macro-Scene of the player's physical room + the inner-Scene of the game-world together compose the Burkean containing-principle.

dissertation_uexkull_mapping.rationale_le60: Strongest Layer-C convergence. Burke's Scene-as-blanket-container parallels Uexküll's Umwelt as the subjectively-constituted environment closing the functional circle. Both arrive at 'motive-locus as bounded subjectively-constituted environment' from non-overlapping traditions. SIGNATURE Burke×Uexküll convergence.

dissertation_ontological_target.rationale_le60: Burke 1945 has 0 Heidegger hits (Phase 0 cite-check). Convergence: Scene as motive-loaded containing-principle resembles Being-in-the-world's circumspective Umsicht; both treat the situation as motive-laden rather than neutral. Anticipatory, not exegetical.

forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.textual_seed: GM-10 p.458 Urn-as-Attitude reading — the Urn-as-scene that has been transmuted into incipient-act-toward-eternity; the scenic frozen-time becomes the attitudinal stance the poem occupies.
forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.modification: Rhetoric of Motives Attitude term will require a Scene-modifier capturing the attitudinal-scene (the situation as already-evaluated, already-oriented-toward — the rhetorical scene of address).

section_A_pentad_terms.operational_definition: Agent is the pentad term naming the doer of any act — the constituting subject from which, in idealist construal, motive originates. Idealism features Agent by deriving scene, act, agency, and purpose from properties of the agent (mind, ego, will, spirit, consciousness, super-agent). Admits subdivision into co-agents (friends) and counter-agents (enemies) and gathers personal properties (will, ideas, malice, intuition, creative imagination) as motive-bearing.
section_A_pentad_terms.question_answered: Who did it? (Whose act is this? In whose consciousness, by which subject?)
paradigm_examples_burke: Hero with co-agent friend and counter-agent villain (GM-00 p.xx)
Dr. Stockmann as agent of the Ibsen Enemy plot (GM-01)
Ego/self/super-ego/consciousness/will/generalized I (GM-05 p.171)
Soul/spirit/oversoul/mind (GM-05 p.171)
Super-persons: church, race, nation, historical period (GM-05 p.171)
Leibnizian monad as atom-agent (GM-05 p.184)
Kantian universalized agent / 'the understanding' (GM-05 p.187)
Marxist class as collective agent (GM-05 p.200)
Hegelian Spirit / World-Historical Hero (GM-05 p.203)
Marianne Moore — appropriate-scene-to-agent ratio (GM-12)
section_A_pentad_terms.burke_exegetical_move: Burke (GM-05) reads idealism as the school whose vocabulary is generated by treating Agent as the Ausgangspunkt. Berkeley is the cleanest exhibit: matter dissolved into ideas (esse is percipi), scenic residue routed through God as 'Almighty Agent.' Hume narrows idealism's circumference (laboratory empiricism), Leibniz rationalizes it (monad as atom-agent with pre-established harmony), Kant universalizes it ('the understanding' as locus of categories solving Hume's medium-demand). Hegel mediates Spirit through history; Marxism inverts but retains agent-featuring through class-as-collective-agent.
decision_rules: If scenic features are derived FROM properties of a subject/mind/consciousness/spirit/will (rather than the reverse): Agent-featuring.
If a putative material/scenic ground turns out to be a 'super-agent' (God as Almighty Agent, Spirit, Nation-Will, Class-Consciousness): Agent, not Scene.
If the philosophy treats consciousness/idea as PRIMARY and matter as derivative/unnecessary: Agent (Berkeley test).
If a collective agent (class, party, race, nation) bears properties (actus, status, consciousness): Agent even where materialist vocabulary dominates.
Distinguish Agent from Agency: a controller is Agency; the player who wields it is Agent; the avatar through which the player acts is also Agent (shifting-agent ratio).
If properties of will, ideas, malice, intuition are gathered under a single locus, that locus is Agent (GM-00 p.xx gathering test).

dissertation_calleja_pim_mapping.rationale_le60: Burke's Agent-with-co/counter-agent structure maps onto Calleja's Shared involvement (the social field of co/counter-players). Dissertation-utility move: treat the player-avatar-character triple as a question of which agent-position holds at which moment — the shifting-Agent ratio Burke develops as agent-as-Janus-term.

dissertation_uexkull_mapping.rationale_le60: Burke's Agent parallels the subjectival pole of Uexküll's functional cycle — the Innenwelt-bearer that receives Merkmal and issues Wirkmal. The personal-properties Burke gathers (will, malice, intuition, creative imagination) parallel the Innenwelt's species-specific receptor/effector schematism.

dissertation_ontological_target.rationale_le60: Burke's gathering-of-personal-properties anticipates psuchē's tripartite (nutritive/sensitive/rational) and Dasein's existential constitution (Befindlichkeit, Verstehen, Rede). No exegetical contact — Burke does not engage either text on these grounds.
corpus_anchors: Heidegger Being and Time §§9-13 (Dasein's existential constitution)

forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.textual_seed: Burke's super-agent inventory (GM-05 p.171) and the Marxist class-as-collective-agent (p.200) seed the Rhetoric's identification/consubstantiation apparatus — the agent's substantial sharing with other agents.
forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.modification: Rhetoric of Motives will require an Attitude-modifier on Agent: the agent's attitudinal-orientation-toward-other-agents (identification, division, consubstantiation). This is the load-bearing forward-bridge to the Calleja-incorporation↔Burke-consubstantiation theoretical move.

section_A_pentad_terms.operational_definition: Agency is the pentad term naming the means, instruments, methods, or mediating media through which an act is brought about. Its diagnostic question is 'How? By what means?'. As motive-locus it features in pragmatism: action explained by the medium that mediates it. Burke distinguishes Agency from Agent (Agency is impersonal mediation; Agent is personal locus) and from Act (Agency is means; Act is the doing). Modern science's elimination of final cause raises Agency to ancestral term.
paradigm_examples_burke: File as instrument of escape in hero-file example (GM-00 p.xx)
Pragmatist nesting: file + hand + brain + educational system (GM-00 p.xxi)
Machines as obvious instruments yet in accumulation constitute industrial Scene (GM-00 p.xx)
Music / piping as agency of address in Keats Ode (GM-10 stanza II)
William James's method-only / cash-value pragmatism (GM-07)
Dewey's intelligence as instrument embodied in scientific method (GM-00 p.xxi; GM-07)
Mead's Philosophy of the Act (GM-00 p.xxi; GM-07)
Bridgman operationalism (GM-07)
Aristotelian organon as 'incipiently pragmatist' (GM-07 p.276)
Procedure/judicial review as Agency in constitutional analysis (GM-08)
section_A_pentad_terms.burke_exegetical_move: Burke (GM-07) diagnoses Pragmatism as the school featuring Agency. James foregrounds method, cash-value, and instrument; Dewey's Instrumentalism makes intelligence-as-method ancestral; Mead names his work 'philosophy of the act' yet his analytical apparatus is agency-foregrounding (the file/hand/brain/educational-system chain). Burke critique: Bridgman's operationalism is the limit-case — he 'writes about his purpose in eliminating the concept of purpose,' demonstrating that instruments carry purpose embedded in structure and design. Burke names pragmatism the 'mediator-form' among the five featurings.
decision_rules: If a vocabulary derives motive from the medium/instrument/method that mediates action: Agency-featuring.
If 'experience' is treated as continuous with 'nature' via instrumental method (Dewey continuity-replaces-separation): Agency-featuring even where act/scene vocabulary survives.
If operations are equated with meaning (Bridgman): Agency-featuring at its limit-case (purpose-elimination paradox).
Distinguish Agency from Act: way-words (hodos, tao, yoga) drift act→agency when method becomes means-of-doing rather than act-of-being (GM-01 p.15).
Money as paradigm Agency (universal medium); cash-value as agency-test (GM-07).
Instruments-in-accumulation become Scene (Biddle pattern, GM-01 p.18) — flag scene-agency transition.

dissertation_calleja_pim_mapping.rationale_le60: Agency = how-by-what-means maps onto Calleja's Kinesthetic (controls as motor mediation) and Ludic (rules as instrumental system through which play-acts are made possible). Burke's 'instruments have purpose embedded in structure and design' is the strongest anticipatory anchor: game-mechanics carry designer-purpose the player exercises without articulating it.

dissertation_uexkull_mapping.rationale_le60: Uexküll's Funktionskreis pairs Merk-Organ (receptor→Merkwelt) with Wirk-Organ (effector→Wirkwelt). This receptor/effector instrumentation is structurally Agency. Burke's 'physiology of mysticism' / 'pre-motion' passages (nervous impulses 'glowing' without muscular discharge) independently arrive at a receptor-effector decoupling description.

dissertation_ontological_target.rationale_le60: Burke himself reads Aristotle's organon as 'incipiently pragmatist' (GM-07 p.276) but emphasizes Aristotle's subordination of agency under final cause. The anchor to technē as craft/productive-knowledge with internal aitia is therefore ANTICIPATORY rather than exegetical — Burke does not pursue this.
corpus_anchors: Aristotle Metaphysics A.1 (technē as productive knowledge)

forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.textual_seed: GM-07's culminating agency-purpose ratio ('Mysticism of Means') and the 'agencies in accumulation become scenic' (Biddle pattern, GM-01 p.18) seed the Rhetoric's analysis of identification-via-shared-instruments.
forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.modification: Rhetoric of Motives Attitude-as-incipient-act will require an Agency-modifier capturing the rhetorical-instrumentality of address (how the orator's instruments embed an attitudinal stance the audience is invited to adopt).

section_A_pentad_terms.operational_definition: Purpose is the pentad term naming the end, telos, or motivating-toward-which of an act. Its diagnostic question is 'Why?'. As motive-locus it features in mysticism: action explained by the cosmic end toward which it is drawn. Burke's mark of mysticism is 'unity of the individual with some cosmic or universal purpose,' not mere unity. Pure Purpose collapses into the paradox-of-substance (docta ignorantia), into mechanism, into the negative; survives implicitly even where formally eliminated.
paradigm_examples_burke: Hero's purpose of escape (GM-00 p.xx)
Aeschylus Erinyes→Eumenides — purpose-transformation (GM-01 p.20)
Plotinus Enneads I.3 journey to the Good (GM-07)
Plato's Good = One (GM-07)
Bonaventura, Thomas à Kempis Imitation of Christ — 'In all things behold the end' (GM-07)
Aristotelian eudaimonia as realistic-not-mystical synonym for Purpose (GM-07)
Tolstoy's drought / James 'Sick Soul' (GM-07 Varieties of Religious Experience)
Eliot Murder in the Cathedral; Little Gidding (GM-07)
Dostoevsky Crime and Punishment — Raskolnikov's representative act (GM-07)
Constitutional 'unwritten clause' of reconciliation (GM-08)
Keats Ode oracular 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty' as ultimate purpose (GM-10)
section_A_pentad_terms.burke_exegetical_move: Burke (GM-07) diagnoses Mysticism as the school featuring Purpose. The mystic Upward Way to the Primal-Principle (Plotinus); the via negativa (Spinoza's omnis determinatio est negatio; Decalogue's 'thou shalt not'); reflexive doublings (Nietzsche eternal recurrence, Eliot's wheel, Shelley's Alastor); the mystic 'moment' / rebirth-grammar; demonic trinity (cloacal-mystical imagery); the Silence-and-Hunt biological substrate. Burke critique: pure Purpose passes into paradox-of-substance (compulsion, mechanism); mysticism arrives at the same narrowing-of-circumference as materialism by absolutizing Purpose into fatality.
decision_rules: If a vocabulary derives motive from cosmic/universal end toward which the act is drawn: Purpose-featuring (mysticism).
If unity-of-individual-with-universal is treated as motive-engine: mysticism (Burke's mark of mysticism, not mere unity).
Aristotelian eudaimonia is NEAR but NOT mystical (realistic synonym; GM-07).
If via negativa replaces positive specification of the end: pure-Purpose limit-case.
If means become end (Mysticism of Means, Huxley pacifism): agency-purpose merger as mystical critique-target.
If purpose is reducible to quantifiable goal-state, it has crossed into Agency-featuring (the metonymy-of-reduction move, GM-13).

dissertation_calleja_pim_mapping.rationale_le60: Purpose = why maps onto Calleja's Ludic dimension (game-goal pursuit as motive-engine of play), Narrative (story-arc as teleological closure), and Affective (regulation/mastery-pursuit). Burke's 'unity of individual with cosmic purpose' is the template for narrative-immersion: player's individual purpose absorbed into the universal purpose-design of the story-world.

dissertation_uexkull_mapping.construct: Closure of the functional loop on a Bedeutungstrager keyed to biological need
dissertation_uexkull_mapping.rationale_le60: Uexküll's Funktionskreis closes when receptor/effector cycle terminates on a meaning-carrier keyed to biological need (food, mate, threat-avoidance). This closure-toward-valenced-object is the purpose-pole. Burke's 'Silence and the Hunt' subsection — 'imagery of the desired as that for which we hunger' — independently converges.

dissertation_ontological_target.rationale_le60: Burke's Purpose-as-end-for-the-sake-of-which converges with the Worumwillen structure but Burke has no exegetical contact with Heidegger. Aristotelian telos anchor is more proximate (Burke names Aristotle's eudaimonia at GM-07) but Burke does not pursue the four-causes mapping here.
corpus_anchors: Aristotle Nicomachean Ethics I (eudaimonia as telos)
Heidegger Being and Time §§18, 26, 41 (Worumwillen / Umwillen / Sorge)

forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.textual_seed: GM-07's via-negativa and reflexive-doubling apparatus seeds the Rhetoric's identification-as-purpose-fusion (identification with the other's purpose as substantial sharing).
forward_reference_to_rhetoric_of_motives.modification: Rhetoric of Motives Attitude-as-incipient-act will reconfigure Purpose as attitudinal-purpose (orientation-toward-end as already-inhabiting-the-end through symbolic anticipation). The Calleja-incorporation parallel: incorporation as substantial absorption of the player into the game-world's purpose-structure.

section_B_ratios_catalog.preamble: Burke's 10 dyadic ratios + selected higher-order combinations. Burke himself singles out scene-act and scene-agent as the only ratios 'fitting with complete comfort' in the container-and-thing-contained framework (GM-01 p.19); act-agent 'tugs at its edges'; the remainder require additional dialectical apparatus.

ratios.name: scene-act
ratios.operational_gloss: Quality of scene implies (contains, calls forth) a correspondingly qualified act; convertibly, the act demands or constructs a scene of corresponding quality. Reversible; deterministic or hortatory; the chapter's titular ratio.
burke_examples: Ibsen Enemy of the People (bourgeois sitting-room/editorial office/disordered study, GM-01 pp.3-5)
O'Neill Mourning Becomes Electra (Lavinia nails shutters, then shut-in scene drives her automaton-march, GM-01 pp.5-6)
Marxist 'objective situation' (GM-01 p.13)
Military maxim 'terrain determines tactics' (GM-01 p.12)
Coleridge Pantisocracy 'to make virtue inevitable' (GM-01 p.14)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does the situation determine / permit / constrain the act?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene implies/contains/calls-forth act. Reverse: act demands/constructs scene (Lavinia's command).
ratios.higher_order: Scene-act-agent triadic deployments — Russian-resistance example (GM-01 p.16) competes scene-act (Soviet structure) vs act-agent (Russian patriotism). Edenic paradigm of total ratification (GM-01 p.19): act-agent → scene-act → scene-agent in unending moment.

ratios.name: scene-agent
ratios.operational_gloss: Synecdochic correspondence between person and place: place-quality implies inhabitant-quality and conversely; contents of a divine container synecdochically share in its divinity. Positional in the strong sense (scene contains agent).
burke_examples: Carlyle Heroes and Hero-Worship on Arabs and Arabian country (GM-01 pp.7-8)
Wordsworth 'It is a beauteous evening' sonnet (GM-01 p.8)
Swift Laputans (GM-01 p.9)
Seurat pointillism (figures dissolving into background, GM-01 p.8)
Idealist Einklang zwischen Innen- und Aussenwelt (GM-01 p.9)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does the situation/environment qualify the agent inhabiting it?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene-quality implies agent-quality. Reverse: agent-traits suffice to construct scene (body as 'scenic' as theologians treat body as dwelling-place of soul, GM-01 p.10).
ratios.higher_order: Whole nineteenth-century intellectual-historical formation built on this single ratio (idealist Einklang). 'Climates of opinion' (Becker), 'scene of ideas' (Locke) combine scene-agent with implicit agent-substrate of ideas.

ratios.name: scene-agency
ratios.operational_gloss: Scene shapes which agencies are available, sustainable, or efficacious; conversely, the introduction of new agencies (technologies, methods) transforms the scene that contains them.
burke_examples: Francis Biddle: all changes refer to agencies of communication (railroad/telegraph/telephone/automobile/movie/airplane/radio) which by accumulation become scenic (GM-01 p.18)
Battlefield case: terrain admits cavalry, denies tanks (reasoned extension)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: What means does this situation afford? What instruments are scenically necessary?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: scene affords/constrains agency. Reverse: new agencies accumulate to become scenic (Biddle pattern).
ratios.higher_order: Biddle case is scene-agency-act triadic: agencies-become-scenic → scenic-agencies motivate acts → unsatisfied needs return motivation to agent (four-term cascade).

ratios.name: scene-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss: Scene shapes which purposes are conceivable, pursuable, or fulfillable within it; conversely, a purpose may project or demand a scene proportioned to it (mystical exegesis).
burke_examples: Hegel positing Reason as Grundprinzip (scene-purpose move; GM-01 p.12)
Mystical-theological sacred geographies / eschatological horizons afford mystical purposes (anticipating GM-07)
Heretical-Judas case: cosmic-Scene of providence reframes betrayal toward divine Purpose (GM-00 p.xxi)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: What ends does this circumference make conceivable?
ratios.directionality: Likely reversible. Burke does not fully develop in GM-01; announces (p.15) it will be examined in GM-07.
ratios.higher_order: Hegelian Reason-as-Grundprinzip is scene-purpose-act triadic (Reason grounds, motivates, and is the substance of historical action).

ratios.name: act-agent
ratios.operational_gloss: Agent authors acts; acts can in turn make or remake the agent. NOT strict containment: agent does not contain the act, though its results might pre-exist virtually within him. Temporal/sequential.
burke_examples: 'Sobering influence of the Presidency on any man' (office shapes occupant; GM-01 p.16)
Priestly vestments and judicial robes transform wearer (GM-01 p.16)
Russian wartime resistance attributed to Russian traits/patriotism rather than socialism (act-agent deflects scene-act, GM-01 pp.16-17)
Democracy as residing in 'a democratic people' (act-agent democracy vs. scene-act democracy, GM-01 p.17)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does what-is-done modify who-does-it? How does agent-character author the act?
ratios.directionality: Temporal-sequential. Forward: agent's nature authors acts. Reverse: acts make or remake agent (offices, vestments, situations shape character).
ratios.higher_order: Picturesque conflict (GM-01 p.18): 'fools in wise situations' = scene-act + act-agent in deliberate non-alignment (Chaplin incongruity; Empson's pastoral).

ratios.name: act-agency
ratios.operational_gloss: Act overlaps with agency when method (met-hodos) becomes means-of-doing rather than act-of-being. Way-words (hodos, tao, yoga, dike) originally act-words drift toward agency under instrumentalist reading.
burke_examples: Burke's way-words analysis (GM-01 p.15): scientific method (met-hodos) as means of doing rather than way of life
Writing as act overlapping with the agency of language (reasoned extension)
Voting as act overlapping with agency of the ballot (reasoned extension)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does the instrument re-characterize the act it instantiates?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: act's character constrains fit agencies. Reverse: agency (method, instrument) re-characterizes the act (scientific-method-as-means turns inquiry into procedure).
ratios.higher_order: Burke's pragmatism mapping (GM-07): Agency-featured philosophies make act-agency the dominant ratio in their motive-analysis.

ratios.name: act-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss: An act is consummated only insofar as it realizes the purpose for which it is done; a purpose is articulate only insofar as it admits expression in a concrete act. Reciprocal teleological closure.
burke_examples: Hero-file: 'break his bonds (act) in order to escape (purpose)' (GM-00 p.xx)
Aeschylean Erinyes→Eumenides as act-purpose total transformation (GM-01 p.20)
Christ 'I am the way' as act-toward-salvation-purpose (reasoned extension)
Constitutional ideal vision's 'unwritten clause' (GM-08)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does the act realize / fail / transform its purpose?
ratios.directionality: Reversible in principle. Burke does not extensively develop in GM-01.
ratios.higher_order: Aeschylus closing example is act-purpose-agent triadic (Orestes' suffering changes Furies' identity, which changes their purpose, which changes their characteristic acts, GM-01 p.20).

ratios.name: agent-agency
ratios.operational_gloss: Agent's character implies fit agencies; agencies habitually employed help constitute agent's character. Symbolic-of-agency mother-locus (GM-07).
burke_examples: Seurat case (GM-01 p.8) — agencies (pointillism medium) constitute the artist's identity
Orator's preferred rhetorical agencies constitute orator's identity (reasoned extension; anticipating Rhetoric of Motives)
Voter as politician's agency (GM-00 p.xx)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How does the agent's choice/habituation of means constitute the agent's identity?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agent-character implies fit agency. Reverse: habituated agencies constitute character.
ratios.higher_order: Burke's pragmatism mapping (GM-07): pragmatist philosophy makes agent-agency the dominant dramatistic relation.

ratios.name: agent-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss: Agent's needs/wants/aspirations generate purposes. Burke locates 'needs' as 'a property of agents' (GM-01 p.18), making agent-purpose the relation between agent-internal motivational properties and their purposive expression.
burke_examples: Biddle analysis: 'needs are a property of agents; hence an act designed to produce a situation more responsive to our needs would have its most direct locus of motivation under the heading of agent' (GM-01 p.18)
Dr. Stockmann's purpose to enroll twelve disciples rooted in his character-as-agent (GM-01 p.5)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: What does the agent want / aim at? How does agent-character generate purposes?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agent-character implies purposes. Reverse: purposes shape/constitute agent.
ratios.higher_order: Biddle cascade (GM-01 p.18): agency → scene → act → agent-purpose four-term motivational sequence ('shift of ratios').

ratios.name: agency-purpose
ratios.operational_gloss: Agency drifts toward its own teleology under sustained use (pragmatism's philosophy of means); purpose conversely shapes which agencies are admissible as fit means. The diagnostic ratio for distinguishing pragmatism (Agency-featuring) from mysticism (Purpose-featuring).
burke_examples: 'The end justifies the means' (and its denial) as agency-purpose dispute (reasoned extension)
Bridgman operationalism — purpose-elimination paradox at agency's limit (GM-07)
Mysticism of Means (Huxley pacifism — GM-07's specifically critiqued limit-case)
Sacraments / prayer / ascetic practice shaped by soteriological purpose (reasoned extension)
ratios.motive_analytic_question: How are means proportioned to ends? Where does instrumental teleology drift toward purpose-replacement?
ratios.directionality: Reversible. Forward: agency drifts toward its own teleology. Reverse: purpose dictates admissible agency-set.
ratios.higher_order: Burke's pragmatism/mysticism pairing in GM-07: agency-purpose is the diagnostic ratio for two schools sharing the ratio but featuring opposite poles. CHAPTER'S CULMINATING RATIO in GM-07.

higher_order_combinations.description: Russian wartime resistance read as scene-act (Soviet structure motivates), act-agent (Russian patriotism motivates), or weighted combination — Burke uses triadic deployment to expose rhetorical-deflection function of ratio-selection.

Mutual ratification: agent acts in keeping with nature (act-agent) → changes scene (scene-act) → likens self to scene (scene-agent). Burke names 'Edenic paradigm' — total acts producing total transformations producing perfect Edenic symmetry.
Orestes' sufferings + Athena's intervention transform Furies' purpose, transforming their characteristic acts and identity — triadic motivational transformation.
Agencies become scenic → scenic-agencies motivate acts → unsatisfied needs return motivation to agent. Four-term cascade illustrating 'shift of ratios.'

directionality_summary.burke_note: Burke (GM-01 p.19) singles out scene-act and scene-agent as the only ratios fitting with complete comfort in the container framework; act-agent 'tugs at its edges'; remainder require additional dialectical apparatus.

section_C_worked_examples.preamble: Burke's three primary worked examples + one dissertation-deployable template for game-user-motive analysis.

example_1_ibsen_enemy_of_the_people.summary: Burke works the five-act structure of Ibsen's Enemy as paradigm scene-act ratio. The bourgeois sitting-room of Acts I-II frames the bourgeois plot; the editorial office of Act III gives forensic coloration to the peripety; the semi-public semi-intimate room of Act IV reflects the semi-public character of Stockmann's appeal; the disordered study of Act V mirrors the hero's post-conflict state. The plot is 'an internality directed outwards.' Dr. Stockmann's plan to enroll twelve disciples and his closing 'stand alone' pronouncement are framed by the disordered study scene.

pentad_terms_in_operation.Act: Stockmann's exposure of contaminated baths; his decision to stand alone; his plan to enroll twelve disciples
pentad_terms_in_operation.Scene: Five distinct rooms keyed to five act-stages (sitting-room → editorial office → public meeting → semi-public room → disordered study)
pentad_terms_in_operation.Agent: Dr. Stockmann as protagonist; townspeople as counter-agents; his family as co-agents
pentad_terms_in_operation.Agency: The medical report as agency of exposure; the press as agency of intended publication (later denied)
pentad_terms_in_operation.Purpose: Health of the town; later transmuted to integrity-against-the-majority

ratios_deployed: scene-act primary (each scene shifts mirrors plot-development)
act-agent (act of exposure remakes Stockmann from physician to prophetic outcast)
scene-agent (sitting-room frames bourgeois agent; disordered study frames post-conflict agent)
example_1_ibsen_enemy_of_the_people.what_the_analysis_discovers: The scene-act ratio is not optional decoration but the master compositional engine: Burke's reading shows that Ibsen's act-divisions are not arbitrary but pentadic — each scene-shift corresponds to an act-phase-shift the scene contains.

example_2_keats_ode_on_a_grecian_urn.source: GM-10 (Symbolic Action in a Poem by Keats)
example_2_keats_ode_on_a_grecian_urn.summary: Burke reads the Ode through the scene-act ratio as prediction-engine: the transcendent act of stanza III requires a transcendent scene to match it ('the quality of the act shares the quality of the scene in which it is enacted,' GM-10 p.454). Stanza V's chiastic 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty' is the urn-as-Attitude personified — the artifact transmuted into an agent. The Urn's incipient act is 'an attitude is an arrested, or incipient act.'

pentad_terms_in_operation.Act: Speaker's apostrophic address (st. I-II); arrested acts of depicted figures (pursuing/piping/lover-near-kiss/sacrifice-procession); poet's symbolic act of making the poem; the transcendent (mental, spiritual) act split off from bodily passion (st. III fulcrum); the Urn's incipient act / Attitude (st. V)
pentad_terms_in_operation.Scene: Urn as scene-of-frozen-time; bodily fever as scene/ground of mental action; deathy-deathless transcendent scene (green altar, little town); scene 'behind' the Urn; 19th-century romanticism + capitalist-individualist property structure
pentad_terms_in_operation.Agent: Speaker/poet; depicted deities/mortals/Bold Lover/fair youth/priest/marble men; Keats himself (body as patient, mind as agent); Urn-as-Attitude personified
pentad_terms_in_operation.Agency: Music/piping as agency of address (st. II); language as mode of action (essay's frame); urn's visual surface (sculpted figures) as agency through which dead world communicates; ekphrasis
pentad_terms_in_operation.Purpose: Oracular 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty'; transcendence of romantic split (aesthetic/practical, beauty/truth); biographically: redemption of bodily suffering by poetic act

ratios_deployed: scene-act (transcendent act requires transcendent scene — Burke's prediction-engine)
scene-agent (urn-as-scene determines depicted agents; romantic-capitalist scene shapes the poet)
act-purpose (the act of poem-making realizes the redemptive purpose)
example_2_keats_ode_on_a_grecian_urn.what_the_analysis_discovers: The Urn-as-Attitude reading at stanza V is the textual seed for Burke's Rhetoric of Motives sixth term. Attitude mediates between potency and energeia: the Urn as arrested act is the limit-case of incipient action that the Grammar's act-vocabulary cannot quite name.

example_3_marianne_moore_oeuvre.source: GM-12 (Motives and Motifs in the Poetry of Marianne Moore)
example_3_marianne_moore_oeuvre.summary: Burke applies dramatism at corpus scale: a poet's body of work as evidence of stable motivational substance. Moore's signature act is attentive descriptive observation. Scene functions as ground that 'contains the same quality' as the final assertive act. Agent and scene-internal agents (armored animals, Irish girl, elephant, unicorn, basilisk) are paired through appropriate-scene-to-agent ratio.
pentad_terms_recessive: Agency (almost wholly absent — Moore is not means-to-ends concerned)
ratios_deployed: act-agent (attentive act expresses agent-character; verses diagnostic of Moore-as-agent)
scene-act (description as logical-compositional ground of the assertive act; 'Spenser's Ireland')
scene-agent (catalogue of correspondences between agents and appropriate scenes; basilisk lives in basilica)
example_3_marianne_moore_oeuvre.what_the_analysis_discovers: The corpus-scale template (5 transfer steps from GM-12): (1) choose corpus boundary; (2) catalog recurrent motifs; (3) identify underlying motivational substance; (4) diagnose featured pentad terms; (5) use one internal exhibit as exegetical key; (6) test substance against the entire corpus.

example_4_dissertation_deployable_templa.label: Game-user-motive analysis template (Calleja's World of Warcraft / Planetside placeholder case)
example_4_dissertation_deployable_templa.applicability: Apply pentad to a paradigmatic player-session, character-build, or community-event in a Calleja Appendix case-game (World of Warcraft, Planetside, EVE, Star Wars Galaxies).

step_1_identify_pentad_terms.Scene: (a) physical room of player; (b) game-world environment (terrain, lighting, soundscape); (c) social field (raid group, guild, server, region); (d) macro-cultural-historical scene (genre conventions, platform, monetization regime)
step_1_identify_pentad_terms.Act: (a) micro: keypress, mouse-click, voice-command; (b) tactic: rotation, kite, combo; (c) strategy: build-order, route-selection; (d) session-arc act: the whole play-session as a single act; (e) campaign-arc act: the player's career in this game
step_1_identify_pentad_terms.Agent: (a) player-as-self (biographical); (b) avatar (in-fiction body); (c) character (narrative role); (d) co-agents (party, guild, faction); (e) counter-agents (PvP opponents, AI antagonists, design-as-counter-agent). FLAG: which agent-position holds at which moment (Burke's shifting-agent ratio)
step_1_identify_pentad_terms.Agency: (a) controller / mouse / keyboard / VR-hardware (Kinesthetic); (b) rule-system / mechanics / cooldowns (Ludic); (c) UI / HUD / minimap (perceptual); (d) communication channels (voice, chat, ping-system) (Shared); (e) third-party tools (DPS-meters, Discord, wikis)
step_1_identify_pentad_terms.Purpose: (a) game-internal goal (quest, raid-clear, ranked-promotion); (b) flow-seeking; (c) affective regulation; (d) social goal (belonging, status, recognition); (e) mastery-pursuit; (f) exploration; (g) narrative-resolution; (h) external goals (streaming, content-creation, esports career)

step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.scene-act: How does the game-world's affordance-structure constrain or enable the session-act? (e.g., Planetside's continental scale enables logistic-acts unavailable in a battle-arena.)
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.act-agent: How does the session-act remake the player-agent? (alterbiography emergence — Calleja Ch. 7)
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.scene-agent: How does the world come to inhabit the player (spatial-internalization)? Burke's body-as-scenic test applied to avatar-as-scenic.
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.act-agency: Where does the act-of-play merge with the agency of the controller? (kinesthetic transparency — the Bridgman-operationalist limit-case)
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.agency-purpose: Where do the available mechanics drift toward becoming their own ends? (the speedrun/grinding/min-max ratio-drift)
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.agent-purpose: What does this player want, given who this player is? (the alterbiography-as-need-generator)
step_2_identify_ratios_in_operation.agency-scene: How does new platform-tech reconfigure the gameworld scene? (Biddle pattern applied to VR / cloud / cross-play)

step_3_calleja_pim_crosswalk.Agent → Shared: The social field of co/counter-players; player-avatar-character triple is the shifting-agent ratio
step_3_calleja_pim_crosswalk.Agency → Kinesthetic+Ludic: Controls + rules-as-means; designer-purpose embedded in mechanics

example_4_dissertation_deployable_templa.what_the_analysis_discovers: The pentad + PIM crosswalk yields a 5×6 cell matrix the dissertation can move through to systematically describe a player-session. Burke's higher-order combinations (scene-act-agent Edenic paradigm) become the diagnostic lens for fully-immersive sessions in which all positional ratios align.

section_D_application_checklist_and_ques.preamble: 35-45 dissertation-deployable analytic questions, grouped by pentad-term × ratio × Calleja-PIM axis. Each group includes parallel Uexküllian + Aristotelian-Heideggerian probes.
scene_spatial_PIM: What features of the virtual environment foreground themselves as containing-principle for the player's acts?
What does the room/physical-context contribute as outer Scene to the player's motive?
Where do scene-cues shift between linguistic and material delivery (Burke GM-01 distinction)?
Uexküll: What is this player's Umwelt — which features of the gameworld register as Merkmal-laden? Which are environmentally present but biosemiotically inert?
Heidegger: Where is this player's circumspective Umsicht — what shows up as ready-to-hand vs present-at-hand?
act_ludic_narrative_kinesthetic_PIM: What is the player's session-arc act? What sub-acts compose it?
Where does act collapse into motion (the Burkean watershed)? What play-segments are 'sheer motion' / mindless grinding?
Where is incipient-act / attitude detectable — moments of suspended decision, rehearsed play, theorycrafting?
Aristotle: What is the act's energeia / entelechy — what kind of thing is this act fully being? What is its proper form?
Where does the act feature as titular (Mead-style 'philosophy of the act' as game-genre ideology)?
agent_shared_PIM: Who is acting — player-as-self? Avatar? Character-in-narrative? When does the agent-position shift?
Who are the co-agents (guild, party, friend-circle)? Who are the counter-agents (opponents, designers-as-counter-agent, the game-system itself)?
Where do super-agents emerge (the playerbase, the community, the studio, the genre)?
Uexküll: What is the player's Innenwelt — which receptor/effector specializations characterize this player-as-subject?
Heidegger: How is this player's Dasein structured by Mitsein (being-with co-agents)?
agency_kinesthetic_ludic_PIM: What means is the player using — controller as instrument? Rule-system as instrument? Other players' moves as instrument?
Where does the act-of-play merge with the agency of input (kinesthetic transparency)?
Which agencies have become scenic by accumulation (Biddle pattern — VR-hardware, voice-chat, streaming-overlays)?
Aristotle: Is this agency technē (productive craft) or organon (subordinated instrument)? Does it carry its own internal aitia?
Bridgman test: Has agency drifted into purpose-elimination paradox (means-as-end)?
purpose_ludic_narrative_affective_PIM: What is the player trying to do? Game-internal goal? Flow? Affective regulation? Social? Mastery? Exploration?
Does this play feature mysticism (unity-with-cosmic-purpose) — narrative-immersion as Burkean mysticism?
Where does pure Purpose collapse into mechanism (compulsion-loop critique)?
Aristotle: What is this play's telos / eudaimonia? Is the goal external (winning) or internal (good-play)?
Heidegger: What is the Worumwillen — for-the-sake-of-which the player plays? Does it survive when stripped of equipment-totality?
scene_act_ratio: How does the game-world constrain or enable the player's acts?
Does this session demonstrate the deterministic surface ('the design made me do it') or the hortatory surface ('the design demands I act')?
Where does the Lavinia-reversal hold: where does the act produce a scene that produces further acts?
act_agent_ratio: How does what-is-being-done modify who-is-doing-it (player's avatar/character/self identification)?
Where is alterbiography emerging — what acts have remade this player-agent?
Where is picturesque-conflict operative (fools in wise situations / wise players in foolish design)?
agency_purpose_ratio: How does the controller/rule-system limit or modify the player's available purposes?
Where does means become end (speedrun / grind / metagame as purpose-drift)?
Is this player a pragmatist (Agency-featuring) or mystic (Purpose-featuring) toward the same agency-purpose dyad?
scene_purpose_ratio: What ends does this game-world make conceivable that others would not?
How does narrative-scene-design dictate purpose-structure (rails-narrative vs. emergent)?
agent_agency_ratio: How do the player's habituated control-schemes / play-styles constitute the player-identity?
Where does Symbolic-of-agency mother-locus emerge (the player's signature build/main/playstyle)?
irony_dialectic_meta_question: Where does the design intent (A) return as its dialectical opposite (non-A) in actual play? (Burke's peripety formula)
Does the analyst deploy classic/humble irony (consubstantiality with the toxic optimizer) or romantic/Pharisaic irony (the toxic player as 'not me')?

section_E_four_layer_integration.preamble: The dissertation's full multi-layer analytical apparatus: 5 pentad terms × 4 augmentation layers. The Manual's central diagnostic table.

calleja_pim_layer.adds: phase distinction (micro-act vs strategy vs session-act); dimensional granularity
calleja_pim_layer.conflicts: Burke's act/motion watershed not in Calleja

uexkull_layer.conflicts: Uexküllian objectivism vs Burke's dramatistic-rhetorical commitments

rhetoric_attitude_forward_ref.modification: Attitude as incipient-act sub-term; spectrum of suspended/rehearsed/symbolic action

calleja_pim_layer.adds: macro-Scene (room) vs inner-Scene (gameworld) distinction; spatial-internalization phenomenology

uexkull_layer.provenance: anticipatory-projection — SIGNATURE Layer-C CONVERGENCE: motive-locus as bounded subjectively-constituted environment, arrived at from non-overlapping traditions

aristotle_heidegger_layer.adds: ontological grounding of situatedness; circumspective Umsicht

rhetoric_attitude_forward_ref.modification: attitudinal-scene = situation-as-already-evaluated; the rhetorical scene of address

calleja_pim_layer.adds: social-field granularity; player-avatar-character triple as shifting-agent ratio
calleja_pim_layer.conflicts: Calleja's individual phenomenological subject vs Burke's super-agent inventory

uexkull_layer.conflicts: biosemiotic individuation vs Burke's symbolic-action collective-agents

rhetoric_attitude_forward_ref.modification: Attitude-modifier as agent's orientation-toward-other-agents → IDENTIFICATION / CONSUBSTANTIATION (the load-bearing forward-bridge)

calleja_pim_layer.adds: kinesthetic-input as constitutive of act-described (Bridgman anchor); rules-as-instrumental-system
calleja_pim_layer.conflicts: Calleja's experiential-control vs Burke's symbolic-mediation framing

uexkull_layer.adds: biosemiotic receptor/effector poles; Burke's 'physiology of mysticism' converges

aristotle_heidegger_layer.conflicts: Burke reads organon as 'incipiently pragmatist' but does NOT pursue technē mapping — anticipatory only

rhetoric_attitude_forward_ref.modification: Agency-modifier as rhetorical-instrumentality of address (orator's instruments embed attitudinal stance)

calleja_pim_layer.conflicts: Calleja's affective-experiential vs Burke's cosmic-mystical Purpose-featuring

uexkull_layer.mapping: Closure of functional loop on Bedeutungstrager keyed to biological need

rhetoric_attitude_forward_ref.modification: attitudinal-purpose = orientation-toward-end as already-inhabiting-end through symbolic anticipation. Calleja-incorporation parallel: incorporation as substantial absorption into purpose-structure.

incorporation_consubstantiation_bridge.claim: The Burke × Calleja primary theoretical move at the dissertation's apparatus-intersection: Calleja's incorporation (player substantially absorbed into game-world) and Burke's consubstantiation (identification through substantial sharing) converge on the same dynamic from incommensurable traditions.
incorporation_consubstantiation_bridge.burke_textual_seed: GM-00 p.xix proto-consubstantial figure ('A may become non-A . . . consubstantial with non-A'); GM-02 substance vocabulary type-16 'consubstantial-substance'; GM-13 irony / dialectic peripety-formula (A returns as non-A).
incorporation_consubstantiation_bridge.calleja_anchor: Incorporation as the 6-dimension absorption of player into world (Calleja PIM Operationalization Manual).
incorporation_consubstantiation_bridge.blocker: Consubstantiation is *Rhetoric of Motives* (1950) vocabulary, not *Grammar* vocabulary. The bridge can be flagged from the Grammar side but not consolidated until the Rhetoric pipeline is built.

umwelt_scene_convergence.claim: Layer C's signature anchor at the Burke × Uexküll intersection. Burke's containing-Scene + Uexküll's Umwelt converge on the same insight (motive-locus is the bounded, subjectively-constituted environment) from non-overlapping traditions.
umwelt_scene_convergence.burke_anchor: Scene as containing-principle / Container and Thing Contained (GM-01); Scene operationalization (GM-04); 'literary situation' borrowing diagnostic (GM-04 p.129).
umwelt_scene_convergence.uexkull_anchor: Umwelt as Merkwelt+Wirkwelt closing functional circle (Uexküll Foray).
umwelt_scene_convergence.risk: Forcing the parallel: Burke's Scene is symbolic-rhetorical-historical-cultural; Uexküll's Umwelt is biosemiotic-objectivist. Genuine convergence at the abstract level but DIVERGENT operationalizations at the concrete level. The dissertation must flag the divergence rather than collapse it.
umwelt_scene_convergence.value_for_dissertation: Two independent disciplinary traditions arrive at the same insight = strong evidence the insight is structural rather than disciplinary artifact.

augmentation_value_summary.calleja_adds: phase distinction + dimensional granularity (the 6 PIM dimensions × 3 phases provide finer-grained resolution than the 5-pentad)
augmentation_value_summary.uexkull_adds: biosemiotic loop closure + tone-coloring (the functional cycle adds a receptor-effector decoupling Burke arrives at independently)
augmentation_value_summary.aristotle_heidegger_adds: ontological grounding of action-as-actualization (Act↔energeia is exegetical; remainder anticipatory)
augmentation_value_summary.rhetoric_attitude_adds: the 6th term + identification/consubstantiation apparatus + attitudinal-modifiers for each existing pentad term (pending future pipeline)

augmentation_conflict_summary.calleja_burke: phenomenological-experiential vs grammatical-linguistic — Calleja describes player-experience; Burke describes motive-statement structure
augmentation_conflict_summary.uexkull_burke: biosemiotic-objectivist vs dramatistic-rhetorical — Uexküll's Funktionskreis is causally-closed; Burke's pentad is rhetorically-open
augmentation_conflict_summary.aristotle_burke: metaphysical-substantialist vs anti-essentialist — Aristotle's energeia is a positive ontological claim; Burke is studiedly noncommittal about whether dramatism is metaphor or ontology
augmentation_conflict_summary.implication: The four-layer apparatus is COMPLEMENTARY rather than UNIFIED. The dissertation must move between layers as appropriate to the analytic question, not collapse them into a single super-framework.
